hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | awk 'BEGIN{rc=0} /\.sops\.ya?ml$/ { f=$0; cmd="grep -c \"ENC\\[\" \"" f "\" 2>/dev/null"; cmd | getline n; close(cmd); if (n+0 == 0) { print "SOPS guard: " f " is plaintext after edit. Run: task sops:encrypt-file file=" f > "/dev/stderr"; rc=2 } } END { exit rc }'

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | awk 'BEGIN{rc=0} { cmd=$0; stripped=cmd; gsub(/"[^"]*"/, "", stripped); gsub(/\x27[^\x27]*\x27/, "", stripped); n=split(stripped, segs, /(&&|\|\||;)/); for (i=1; i<=n; i++) { seg=segs[i]; sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", seg); sub(/^rtk[[:space:]]+/, "", seg); sub(/^sudo[[:space:]]+/, "", seg); if (seg ~ /^git[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)/) { r=system("task sops:verify >/dev/null 2>&1"); if (r != 0) { print "SOPS guard: task sops:verify FAILED. Plaintext secret staged. Run: task sops:verify" > "/dev/stderr"; rc=2 } } } } END { exit rc }'
